---
name: nested-read
description: Inspect independent lane profiles with exact fixed bindings.
---

```toml composition
[[compositions]]
name = "nested-read"
execution = "inline"
branch_failure_policy = "continue_independent"
[[compositions.nodes]]
id = "lane-a"
tool = "keeper_lane_status"
[compositions.nodes.input]
kind = "literal"
value = {}
[[compositions.nodes]]
id = "lane-b"
tool = "keeper_lane_status"
[compositions.nodes.input]
kind = "literal"
value = {}
[[compositions.exports]]
name = "profile"
node = "lane-a"
pointer = "/profile"
```
